name: Ryuuji
source:
He's a young man who, despite graduating from Tokyo U, is working at Live House 696 as a soundboard apprentice because of his great love for music. The headphones always hanging around his neck are his trademark. 
He's also good at taking care of others and teaching Shoichi his job. However, because of his intellect, and his kind personality, Chika tends to dump her homework onto him.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/r18/Titles/Details/FC264AC0-795A-4FEB-AA09-56BAEF3B2FC3/deardrops]MangaGamer[/url]]
